lastCompletedStory.title: Respawn the loop's own children (dashboard, sidecar, watchers) by execPath

nextStoryContext: All five self-respawn sites now build their argv from an injected execPath/argv1 pair instead of a literal 'cam' PATH lookup, via a new generic helper `buildSelfSpawnArgv(execPath, argv1, ...subcommandArgs)` added to src/util/self-invoke.ts (thin wrapper over resolveSelfInvokeArgv from US-001, spread + append, mirroring forkMonitor exactly). Each call site got a small pure, exported, injectable builder so tests assert real argv shape instead of mock-call tautologies: buildDashboardRespawnArgv/buildSidecarSpawnArgv/buildRecycleWatchSpawnArgv/buildSidecarLivenessWatchSpawnArgv in src/commands/run.ts, and buildSidecarRespawnArgv in src/commands/sidecar-liveness-watch.ts. The dashboard pane respawn (tmux respawn-pane, DIRECT exec no bash -c) now spreads the builder's argv after '-t <dashboardPaneId>'; the three Bun.spawn sites (sidecar, orch-recycle-watch, sidecar-liveness-watch) pass the builder's argv array directly as Bun.spawn's cmd. Confirmed via a real tmux manual-page fetch AND a real-tmux integration test that `respawn-pane` given >=2 trailing arguments execs them directly via execvp (no shell re-join/re-split), so a runtime+script pair with internal-space path elements survives unmangled -- this was the exact risk class the US-004 note in this same PRD's patterns.md CAM-55 anchor warns about, now empirically closed for THIS specific site rather than assumed. GOTCHA carried forward from US-002's own notes field (still true post-implementation): in dev/interpreted mode a respawned sidecar/watcher/dashboard child now advertises `<bun> <script> <subcommand>` in `ps` instead of a literal `cam <subcommand>`, which is precisely the discovery breakage the next story (US-004, if scoped that way) must absorb -- grep patterns.md for 'sidecar liveness' / 'ps' / 'discovery' before touching any code that parses `ps` output for these child processes. Quality spine (bun run check:all) required one file-size ceiling raise for src/commands/run.ts (1169->1221, the 6 new pure builder exports + docs pushed it over); scripts/file-size-budget.json's _ref was updated and staged per protocol, no other budget touched.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed respawn-pane/new-window/split-window treat >=2 trailing arguments as a direct execvp argv vector (no sh -c re-join), only a SINGLE trailing argument goes through $SHELL -c. This is exactly the shape all five self-respawn sites now rely on (execPath + optional argv1 + subcommand args = 2-4 elements), confirmed empirically too via test/integration/dashboard-pane-selfspawn.test.ts.
